validation.expected: All independently captured bytes and stores equal, including old padding and retained allocations; original code/trace/source/control lineage qualifies; malformed inputs reject. Unobserved optional branches are source/synthetic evidence only.
validation.actual: Passed: ten exported source bodies and 3,004 instructions qualified; 16 trace guards, 178 original records, 248 exact control comparisons (124 per capture), all captured C++ save/restore bytes and nine rejected corruptions. Independent review rebuilt the exact original-input SHA-256 and passed ASan/UBSan. Three connected public synthetic test groups pass.
validation.tolerance: Exact source, integer, pointer-correlation, byte and hash equality. No padding masks, output-derived oracles, native tick-rate assumption or unobserved runtime result.

limitations: Original execution covers Disc 1 field 23, one ordinary encounter-victory-return route. The two traces repeat that route and are not independent scenarios.
No optional +110/+114 actor extension is exercised. Their flag, size, pointer and allocation ordering rules have source review and synthetic tests only.

The actor-before hook at 800a3940 follows descriptor auxiliary/low-flag stores. Restored descriptor equality is valid at that boundary; distinct high-flag retention is also reviewed and synthetically tested.

Full global meaning, raw pointer repair and native ownership are open. Allocator callback failure is not transactional native rollback. The original writer can request diagnostic printing, outside this pure data module.
The 19 later sprite-replay entries are observations only. Sprite allocation/rebinding, checkpoint policy, ordinary animation VM, complete return variants and control readiness remain open.

Entry, teardown, sprite replay and party-resource exports outside the three listed implementation functions remain dependencies or provisional analysis. Source-byte qualification alone does not recover them.
Memory-card persistence, combat/results, complete loaders, media, timing, all 15 broad Phase 1 todos and all nine slice proof domains remain open.
